steps.title: Make simple geometry
steps.body: Draw a small face or box that can become an object prototype.

steps.title: Select the geometry
steps.body: Switch to Select and choose the geometry. The Selection panel should show counts.

success.description: Manual until state API is wired.

steps.title: Create an object
steps.body: Use `Ctrl+G` or the group command to create an object prototype from the selection.

success.prompt: The object appears in the Objects panel or is selected as a group.

steps.title: Understand edit context
steps.body: Double-click the object when you intend to edit its definition. Exit object edit before continuing top-level modeling.

actions.description: Context entry is currently a user interaction step.

success.prompt: You can tell whether you are editing the object or the top-level model.
